assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only konosuba:ozuma@original-light-novel#expanded-cohort-monograph, the active_provisional KONOSUBA_OZUMA_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the YORI-01 U024 paragraph and ruby projection (P1-472), which rests on Kazuma's retrospective narration, direct exchanges and reported histories. The KonoSuba CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md was read for method, authority order and scope only. The project-local two-rule KONOSUBA_OZUMA_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md, its expanded evidence files, the cohort 43 evidence index, ledgers, readings and the Japanese source are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the monograph's own description of that model is read only as a statement of its scope. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The single YORI-01 U024 visit, from Ozuma's self-introduction at P21 to the principals' prostration at P472, with no default state beyond that ending. His companion's death at Hans's hands and his revenge training (P430) are his own report, not observed states. Whether he keeps or abandons the P422 credibility judgment, and any later appearance, are outside this assessment, and no in-world calendar time is fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph argues two local tendencies, a reciprocal exchange norm (P25-26 help before payment; P76 protection of the informant's meal) and capability-based credibility (P422 power taken as proof that bad reports are slander), and itself declines a mature model or uniquely identified mechanism, naming ordinary reciprocity, companion loyalty, generic gratitude and the story's reversal structure as serious rivals. That supports bounded canon questions about one visit, not a motive hierarchy.

Within one visit the monograph orders located shifts: practical help and threat (P21-P156), the stop at a property-damage warning (P173-175), two weeks of work, the danger warning (P394-395), thanks and the credibility error (P422-463). This is an intra-episode sequence, not a developmental trajectory; his state after P472 is unknown.

Located printed functions only: plain 俺 self-introduction (P21), the explained exchange norm (P76), contracted accusatory threat (P149/156), rougher plain phrasing with カズマさん (P422) and thanks with a deep bow (P436-437). The monograph rejects a fixed polite/rough binary and disclaims acoustic delivery or a vocabulary generator.

Eating, payment for information, minor unpaid help and two weeks of public guild work (P252-255) are located; exact income, appetite, household routines and fixed cost tolerance are stated as unshown.

Differentiated conduct toward an unknown stranger (P25-26), a paid informant (P76), Megumi under pressure (P194-196), Kazuma as accused and then as benefactor (P149/156, P436-437) and his travelling companions. Each relation rests on one or two scenes, and companions' histories are expressly not his.

The monograph has no Ozuma focalization; everything passes through Kazuma's retrospective narration, and his grief and revenge history are his own spoken report (P430). Self-reproach (P330-334) and gratitude are spoken acts, graded under other dimensions. No interior model is established, which is not evidence that he lacks one.

Shouting, a duel demand and a death threat (P149/156), the stop when Kazuma threatens a property-damage charge while the dispute stays active (P173-175), and protective interruption of Megumi's apology (P194-196). The monograph rejects both the fearless-justice and harmless-bluster readings. One dispute does not establish escalation rules.

Located stances: the meal as fair exchange owed to the informant (P76), legal consequence as an inhibitor (P173-175), personal thanks for an avenged companion (P436-437), and the promise to challenge future defamation that overreaches the evidence (P422, P458). No deliberation on an unfamiliar question is shown.

The monograph treats the comic doubles and reversals as the work's structure magnifying anger and humiliation, not as Ozuma's own play. Grading that structure as his repertoire would misattribute it; no play repertoire is established.

One complete 472-paragraph unit projection with ruby, paragraph scope only, no image or whole-edition credit, and a retrospective first-person narrator; the monograph is a bounded expanded-cohort study, not new whole-book primary reading.

Affirmative located countercases: unpaid help (P25-26) against a reading from his threatening appearance; accurate danger perception (P394-395) against his explanation errors (P330-334, P369-375); and his repetition of an allegation grounded in actual party conduct (P463) against his new trust. They are one project's adjudication of one visit.

Claims are bound to paragraph locators within the visit, and the monograph separates reported past (P430) from narrated present and leaves the post-P472 outcome open. There is no default state, knowledge-cutoff discipline beyond the visit, or calendar placement.

scenario_readiness.note: Five located printed functions in one visit, with the monograph's explicit refusal of a universal vocabulary generator and of acoustic claims, do not support new Ozuma lines. They can check whether a proposed line contradicts his attested address forms.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The YORI-01 U024 visit, P21-P472, with the P422 credibility judgment the last attested state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kazuma and his party as strangers, accused and then benefactors; Ozuma's companions Akyua, Megumi and Rakuresu; guild members.
setting_constraints: Axel town, guild work and nearby wolf-hunting situations of the kinds narrated in U024
No later appearance, project-local model rule or uncurated evidence
Printed Japanese only, no performed voice

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph states that it claims no reliable unfamiliar transfer and that a context separating admired power from a conflicting obligation could revise its account; the two tendencies have unexcluded rivals. A novel situation inside the scope can be checked against located conduct, not predicted.

Ordinary conduct is located (meal exchange, payment, guild work), but the monograph states that routines, income, appetite and cost tolerance are unshown and offers no procedure for a new ordinary scene.
The exchange norm and legal inhibition are located once each, and the P422 judgment shows his credibility reasoning overreaching; no procedure for a new ethical choice follows.
Romantic preferences are stated as unshown; nothing romantic is established, which neither supports nor denies readiness.

Two weeks of acknowledged guild work, a pessimistic injury appraisal overturned by Aqua's healing (P294) and the danger warning (P394-395) are located, but the monograph supplies no audited record and no rule for adventurer conduct in a new job.

known_limits.statement: The monograph separates Ozuma's errors about explanation and intention (accepting Kazuma's bear-and-wolf story, P330-334; reading the silver arrow as foresight, P369-375) from accurate situational perception (the wolves have not dispersed, P394-395); neither a general credulity rule nor general competence may be inferred.

At P422 he treats witnessed power as proof that bad reports are envious slander and promises to challenge future defamation (P458), then repeats an allegation grounded in actual party conduct (P463); power, gratitude and good conduct must remain separate evidential questions when modeling his judgments.
The companion killed by Hans and his revenge training are his own report (P430), not observed events, and do not explain all earlier conduct; he arrived with more than one purpose.
Akyua, Megumi and Rakuresu are not aliases of Kazuma's party, and the parallel composition supplies no shared psychology; companions' biographies are not Ozuma's history.

The project-local two-rule reconstruction model, its expanded evidence files, ledgers, readings, the evidence index and the Japanese source are not curated on this subject and were not assessed; missing support is not evidence that any trait or capacity is absent.
